observations: A single solar panel leaning against a wall.
The panel has a dark frame and a grid of cells.
A watermark 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' is visible across the center.
The panel is indoors, next to a window, suggesting it is not currently generating power.
No brand name, model number, or technical specifications are visible on the front.

claims.evidence: The panel is shown indoors and cannot be tested for output remotely.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The panel may be a low-wattage or third-party brand model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may have internal cell damage or micro-cracks.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the open-circuit voltage (Voc) in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: The panel may be a used or refurbished unit despite the seller's description.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear label showing the manufacturing date (Year and Week).

proof_requests: Photo of the label on the back of the panel showing the brand, model, and wattage.
Photo of the serial number on the back label.
A video showing a multimeter reading of the panel's voltage in sunlight.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
